stories.title: Cavs add ex-lottery pick Hezonja after Euro stint
stories.summary: The Cavaliers have agreed to a one-year, $2.8 million deal with Mario Hezonja, the No. 5 pick in the 2015 draft who has shined in the EuroLeague since last playing in the NBA in the 2019-20 season.

stories.title: Sources: A's star Langeliers may miss rest of '26
stories.summary: Athletics All-Star catcher Shea Langeliers could miss the remainder of the 2026 season after suffering a torn meniscus in his right knee, sources told ESPN.
